title: Targeted Enrichment Sequencing with a respiratory pathogen panel for genomic wastewater-based viral epidemiology in Uruguay.
description: In this study, we aimed to assess the performance of the Respiratory Pathogen ID/AMR enrichment (RPIP) kit within a Wastewater-based epidemiology framework for the detection of a panel of respiratory and enteric viral pathogens in wastewater samples collected from Uruguay.
samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from metagenome
